description: This file defines custom exception classes, a model info class for interfacing with a VLLM-based API, and utility functions for environment setup and model retrieval.

classes.name: VLLMError
classes.description: Custom exception class inheriting from BaseLLMException, representing errors specific to VLLM interactions.

classes.name: VLLMModelInfo
classes.description: Class providing methods to validate environment, retrieve API base and key, list models, and get error class for VLLM models.

methods.name: VLLMModelInfo.get_api_base
methods.description: Retrieves the API base URL from parameters or environment variable 'VLLM_API_BASE'.

methods.name: VLLMModelInfo.get_api_key
methods.description: Returns None; placeholder for retrieving API key if needed.

methods.name: VLLMModelInfo.get_base_model
methods.description: Returns the provided model string as the base model.

methods.name: VLLMModelInfo.get_models
methods.description: Contacts the VLLM API to list available models, raising errors if environment variables are not set.

methods.name: VLLMModelInfo.get_error_class
methods.description: Constructs and returns a VLLMError object based on error message, status code, and headers.
